# @workspacekit/create-workspace

> A one-command starter that copies a tested example (Next.js or Vite) into a new folder, with exact `@workspacekit/*` versions.

- API reference: https://adityazero4.github.io/workspacekit/api/create-workspace
- Install: `npm create @workspacekit/workspace my-files -- --template vite`

## README sections

- Install: You do not install it.
- Entry
- Standalone use: The command is a thin wrapper over `createWorkspace`, which you can call from a script:
- CSS: None.
- Options: `--template next|vite`: which example to copy.

## Entry points

- `@workspacekit/create-workspace`

## Exports of `@workspacekit/create-workspace`

- `CreateWorkspaceOptions`: Input of {@link createWorkspace}.
- `TEMPLATE_NAMES`: The starters this package can generate.
- `TemplateName`: One of {@link TEMPLATE_NAMES}.
- `createWorkspace`: Copies a starter into `directory` and pins every `@workspacekit/*` dependency to an exact version.
